title: [finding] `JobSchema.body`'s published describe still says `os package install` excepts every `pull` job, which PR #21683 now refuses when its mapping does not bind
body:
Filing-gate class ① (a defect with a named location), under the exception for wrong text that a release fixes in place: the sentence ships in `@objectstack/spec` (`src/**/*.zod.ts` is in `files[]`) and renders into a generated reference page. Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01T9u38rswFp5Rw8DswRUReJ`, seat post #6017) as the carrier `domain:cli` seat 1 escalated to it (`5976894663`, addendum `5977241800`). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## Where

- `packages/spec/src/system/job.zod.ts:322` at `origin/main` `1db5322ba2`, in `JobSchema.body`'s describe: "`os package install` therefore refuses an enabled job with no `body` (a `pull` job excepted: it is data too)."
- The generated `content/docs/references/system/job.mdx` renders the same sentence.

## Why it is wrong now

PR #21683 (#21672, merged as `413869dfe1`'s merge) makes install-local refuse a `pull` job whose mapping does not bind, as it refuses a `body` job that does not bind. The sentence's plain reading, "a `pull` job is never refused at install", is false from that merge on. The sentence was true when #20281's stage ③ (PR #21668) wrote it.

**Reach:** the describe and the reference page are read by authors and by agents writing jobs; nothing else repeats the rule there. `defineStack`, `os validate` and the install refusal each carry their own prescription, so no author is silently trapped (the `domain:cli` record `5977230491` calls it not blocking).

## The fix (a one-sentence describe change)

The sentence says a `pull` job installs when its mapping binds and is refused when it does not. Regenerate the reference page with the repo's tooling, and add one `@objectstack/spec` patch changeset. No schema, key or behaviour change.

**Who acts:** `domain:spec` seat 1, which dispatches it once triage routes the card (or the next PR that touches `job.zod.ts` carries it, whichever comes first).

Dedupe: `mcp__github__search_issues` (repo-scoped, semantic, closed included), `JobSchema body describe pull job excepted os package install refuses job with no body` → 6 hits, 0 duplicates. #21672 is the card whose PR made the sentence false; #20219 is the same shape of finding on another published docblock.

Dedupe words: `job describe pull excepted install refuses` · `JobSchema body describe stale pull bind` · `job.mdx pull install refusal`
